outer_ring.description: The largest concentric circle defining the outer boundary of the entire cosmological/astronomical diagram. Text in red ink runs along its inner perimeter in an arc. The ring occupies most of the folio width.

inner_ring.description: A second, smaller concentric ring inside the outer ring. This ring, together with the radial sector_dividers, creates the segmented 'wheel' structure. Each segment (sector) between the inner_ring and the central area contains a face_moon_glyph and sector text (the @Pb groups).

sector_dividers.description: Approximately 12 radial lines extending from the center outward, dividing the wheel into pie-shaped sectors. Each sector corresponds to one @Pb label group plus one +L0 face label. The sectors appear to represent months or zodiacal divisions.

central_star_glyph.description: A large multi-pointed star (8-pointed or compass rose style) drawn at the geometric center of the diagram, rendered in golden/brown ink with a green/blue-tinted center. This is the @Ls anchor — the 12 @Ls/&Ls labels are associated with this central star.

face_moon_glyphs.description: Small circular glyphs depicting a human face with a red/brown half-circle (representing moon phases). Approximately 12 such glyphs, one per sector, positioned in the mid-ring zone between the inner ring and the central area. Each has a +L0 label assigned to it.

tally_marks.description: Groups of vertical tally/stroke marks visible at the top edge and right margin of the folio, drawn in a different ink. These appear to be counting marks or registration marks, not Voynichese text.

bottom_paragraph_zone.description: The zone below the outer_ring containing the 3-line @P0 paragraph block (loci 72–74). This is the only full paragraph text on this folio, written in the bottom margin below the diagram.
